said.q: In this landscape, Cézanne uses short, dynamic parallel brushstrokes of yellows, orange and ochre to depict a sandy road, which leads through the tall trees, past a field with corn sheaths to a lake. A few houses and a factory chimney are visible behind the short bushes.

events.n: hedged ("may have painted"); summer, while visiting Camille Pissarro
events.q: In that case Cézanne may have painted this landscape in the summer of 1881, while visiting Camille Pissarro in Pointoise.
